name: Ruby Corbice
source:
Ruby is an emerging artist who came from the royal capital. She often draws in silence, but sometimes she divulges random words for a reason that even she doesn't know. It tends to annoy the protagonist.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20020208134318/http://www.web-giga.com/win31/kingdam.htm]the official site[/url].]
